verdict.rationale: Casium's own pages cover the human-review side: "Licensed attorneys review and sign every filing" and visa guides are "Reviewed by licensed immigration attorneys." On the automation side it offers only vague phrasing ("one intelligent platform," "software built for immigration") and never says what AI does in petition drafting or review. Missing for 10: any explicit statement of AI use in drafting or review, a breakdown of which steps are automated versus attorney-checked, and a dedicated AI-practices or methodology page.
